> This project is a VU (volume unit) meter, which will hear sounds and display their volume with the number of LEDs that light up. For example, during a song's loud sections, it will light up many of its leds, and during the quiet sections, it will light up only a few of the leds. The microcontroller it will use is the Seeeduino XIAO rp2040. The microphone it will use is the MAX4466. The LEDs it will use is the NeoPixel Stick - 8 x 5050 RGB LED with Integrated Drivers.
